# Angular Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Angular

## Overview

Writes comprehensive unit and integration tests for Angular applications using TestBed, component harnesses, and mocking strategies

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [angular-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
angular-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@angular-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure TestBed with proper providers and declarations
- Use component harnesses for reliable DOM testing
- Mock services and HTTP calls with HttpClientTestingModule
- Test observables and async operations with fakeAsync

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Angular Testing Guide**: Official testing patterns for components, services, and pipes
- **Component Harnesses**: CDK component harness API for reliable testing
- **Coverage Standards**: Minimum 80% branch coverage for critical paths
